items.title: Dick Hyman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: it might be Richard Strauss in particular

ctx.x: Sometimes musicians themselves seem to maybe not listen as much because it’s like their job every day.

Well, yeah, no I like to listen to — I don’t necessarily listen to a great deal of jazz, although a fair amount of that, but I like to listen to classical music. We have a local public radio station in Florida that does a wide variety of stuff. But if I have my own inclination, tapes I might put in the car to play, it might be Richard Strauss in particular.
